questions.prompt: Pot is $30. Villain bets $15. Your call closes the action. The pot becomes…
questions.explanation: Thirty plus fifteen plus your fifteen is sixty.

questions.prompt: You have $80 and villain has $200. You are all-in for $80 into a $40 pot. Villain calls. The pot you can win is…

choices.text: The whole $200 stack plus the pot with no matching.

questions.explanation: Villain only matches your $80. Their extra $120 stays behind.

questions.prompt: Counting the pot in a live game is easiest if you…

choices.text: Ask an opponent to count for you mid-decision and trust them.
Track the action street by street, then confirm with the dealer if needed.
Ignore the pot and use only your stack.

questions.explanation: Rebuild the pot from the bets you saw. The dealer can confirm.

questions.prompt: A short all-in call that does not match a raise still…

choices.text: Creates a main pot for the all-in amount and may leave a side pot.

questions.explanation: Eligibility follows how much each player put in.
